reasoning_content:
The container is running. But pnpm is failing: `libatomic.so.1: cannot open shared object file`. This is because the node binary (v24) requires libatomic. Let's install libatomic1.

I'll fix pnpm by installing libatomic1.

action.command: apt-get install -y libatomic1 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "---retry---"; pnpm --version 2>&1
